explanation: A row that can point to another row in the same table through a foreign key is a recursive relationship. Because each product can reference at most one predecessor, the mapping is recursive one-to-many: many products may share the same predecessor, while each product points to at most one predecessor.

options.text: It is a recursive one-to-many relationship mapped with a foreign key back to the same table
It is a many-to-many relationship that requires a bridge table
It is a one-to-one relationship because each product has at most one predecessor
It cannot be enforced with a foreign key because self-references are impossible

prompt: A product table has columns product_id, product_name, and predecessor_id. Each product can have at most one predecessor, and that predecessor must be another row in the same table. If a product has no predecessor, predecessor_id is NULL. Which statement is true about this design?
